'''Premier''' was a title used to denote the leader of [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], dictator [[Suribran Tu]] held the office of [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] premier until his execution by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].
